{"id":"mimid-1wgh.4.81.37","title":"Decision: a Commit that changes the did_webvh record removes members lacking AppDataUpdate (details of mimid-4lp4.3)","description":"Details of Mark's decision in mimid-4lp4.3 (2026-11-19): in a did_webvh room a member whose MLS stack lacks AppDataUpdate (stock mls-rs) is allowed, and a Commit that must change the did_webvh_heads record also removes such members. mls-extensions-11 §4.7: "Changing the app_data_dictionary extension after creation therefore requires that every member that processes the Commit supports the AppDataUpdate proposal, except members removed by that Commit (Section 12.2 of [RFC9420])".

1. What counts as lacking. Readings: (a) the leaf's capabilities.proposals does not list proposal type 0x0008 app_data_update (mls-extensions-11 §7.2.1; RFC 9420 §7.2, §12.2); (b) also members that do not list app_data_dictionary (0x0006) in capabilities.extensions. Chosen: (a) only, judged on the leaf in the current epoch (before the Commit), which is the leaf OpenMLS checks (validate_proposal_type_support, valn0311). (b) cannot happen in a group with the record: the record lives in the GroupContext app_data_dictionary and mimid requires every leaf to list the record component in its own app_data_dictionary (mls-extensions-11 §5), which RFC 9420 §7.2 only allows if capabilities.extensions lists 0x0006. A leaf added by the same Commit is not checked (it does not process the Commit; OpenMLS does not check it either); it is removed by the next record change.

2. Which Commits. Only a Commit that carries an AppDataUpdate of the record component (a new did_webvh user, a newer log, a revocation, whether the record change comes from the committer, the caller, or a stored proposal). An AppDataUpdate of any other component (participant_list, room policy) does not trigger removals: those changes still fail with UnsupportedProposalType while such a member is in the group. INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC.

3. Committer. Member::commit adds the Removes itself, beside the revoked-device Removes of the rules, also when the Commit covers another device's Update proposal (decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.31). The committer's own leaf is never removed. The Commit reports them as CommitBundle::removed_without_app_data_update; a receiver's CommitSummary::removed_without_app_data_update and the Observer's CommitDetail::did_webvh_removes_without_app_data_update report the same set: every Remove in a record-changing Commit whose leaf lacks AppDataUpdate, whether the committer's rules added it or the caller asked for it (a Commit that removes such a leaf on purpose would have had to anyway).

4. Hub. Such Removes are authorized without a room-policy capability, as the revoked-device Removes are (decisions mimid-1wgh.4.81.26, .31): only for a member committer, only when the Commit carries an AppDataUpdate of the record component, only for leaves whose capabilities lack 0x0008. Everything else in the Commit, including a Remove of a leaf that lists AppDataUpdate, goes through room policy. The hub policy input merges both kinds into Commit::did_webvh_required_removes (the reason does not matter to policy).

5. participant_list. Readings: (a) remove the user too (participant_list AppDataUpdate in the same Commit), (b) remove only the clients, like a kick of a client, and keep the user in participant_list. Chosen: (b). The user can rejoin with a client that supports AppDataUpdate, or with the same one when no record change is pending, without being re-invited, and the Commit does not need a participant_list change (which needs canRemoveUser and is itself an AppDataUpdate). Room-policy implications: room-policy-04 allows a listed participant with no clients; role constraints (minimum active participants, §5) still apply: a Commit that would leave a role below its minimum active count is still refused (check_constraints is not bypassed), as are max_clients etc. A participant without clients receives nothing until it rejoins.

new_value: {"notes":"Also: in a MIMI room participant_list and room-policy changes are AppDataUpdates too; OpenMLS still refuses them while such a member is present (not in scope; only the record triggers removal). An external Commit removes no such member (CommitBundle of join_external reports none). The removed mls-rs member cannot parse the removing Commit (AppDataUpdate of 0xF013 -\u003e SerializationError) and learns of its removal only via EpochNotFound."}
